To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

people have an innate propensity to seek out, engage in, and thrive on activities that are interesting and challenging, that they are more likely to do so when they feel they can choose to do so, and that they are more inclined to do so when their relationships with others are characterized by caring and support.
human behavior is regulated by three psychological needs, competence, autonomy, or relatedness.
the satisfaction of basic psychological needs for autonomy, competence and relatedness is both necessary and sufficient for intrinsic motivation, well being and intellectually fulfilling performance.
In summary, our research is concerned with
human beings as active, self motivated, and intentional agents rather than as passive products of genetic endowment or environment

the extent to which people live and work in ways that are consistent with their intrinsic motivations, with their basic psychological needs, and with the sense of well being that accompanies such a lifestyle.

understanding and explaining the factors and processes that cause human beings to turn out the way they do, particularly the ways in which people become more self determined, autonomous, and socially integrated, versus the ways in which they become more controlled, passive, and alienated from one another.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

self determination theory provides a broad and inclusive framework for understanding the nature of human motivation and personality development and that the theory has generated a substantial body of findings that are highly supportive of its basic tenets.

self determination theory has made a substantial contribution to our understanding of the social contextual conditions and processes that promote versus undermine intrinsic motivation and psychological health.
the satisfaction of basic psychological needs is a prerequisite for high quality motivation, development, and well-being.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the more a person’s behavior is under his or her own volitional control and the more he or she feels a sense of self efficacy, choice, and autonomy, the more likely it is that the behavior will be sustained over time and that the person will experience well being.

the satisfaction of the psychological need for autonomy, competence, and relatedness is essential for intrinsic motivation and well being and that these needs are most likely to be satisfied when individuals are offered choices and are provided with the resources and information they need to exercise their personal agency.
human beings have an inherent tendency to behave in effective and satisfying ways.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the social context can be arranged to facilitate versus undermine the basic psychological needs that are critical for psychological growth and well being.
human beings have an inherent tendency to develop in the direction of psychological health, provided that their psychological needs are supported.

people are not motivated by external control, but by their own intrinsic motivation, and that this intrinsic motivation can be enhanced by the provision of autonomy support, structure, and relatedness.
